summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a Form 6-K reporting weekly open-market share repurchases under an existing buyback program. Over 08-11 June 2026, it bought ~3.55 million ordinary shares from UBS as principal, at average prices of 587-598 GBp per share, with a total implied value of about £20.7 million. The shares will be cancelled, reducing share count. The program was announced in February 2026. This is a routine capital return execution, not a tender offer or issuer self-tender. Watch for continued buyback pace and impact on EPS.
